# `jouet diag check`

- **Usage:** `jouet diag check [--changed] [--max <N>] [FILES]…`

Check files and report every finding

Each check also remembers, per file, what it found in that version of the file, which is what `jouet diag delta` compares with.

## Arguments
- **`[FILES]…`** — Files to check (default: --changed)

## Flags
- **`--changed`** — The files that differ from HEAD or are untracked
- **`--max <N>`** — Show at most N findings (default 50); the rest are counted
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
